documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% YoY increase in revenue from operations to ₹ 472.2 crores for Q1 FY27. EBITDA for the quarter grew by 44.5% YoY to ₹ 92.3 crores with margins at 19.2%, while PAT increased to ₹ 65.6 crores. The company is advancing an ongoing ~₹ 200 crore debottlenecking capex to expand ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA by September 2026. The project is fully funded through internal accruals with zero gross debt. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported its FY26 financial and operational performance, highlighting a capacity expansion initiative from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA with commissioning targeted by September 2026.

guidance.claim: Optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust growth in end-user industries such as consumer durables and automotive will drive domestic demand for ABS.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward higher-margin specialty and colored grades away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

capex_expansion.claim: The implementation of the capacity expansion from 75,000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well with orders placed for critical long-delivery equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: The commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to Rs 92.3 crores, with EBITDA margins at 19.2% compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA for FY26 grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.
margins_costs.quote: for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%;

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that PAT rose by 30.6% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 51.6 crores, with margins at 15.1%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT rose by 30.6% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 51.6 crores, with margins at 15.1%;

margins_costs.claim: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42% compared to 17.43% for FY 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA during FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for the financial year stood at 71,501.12 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the year stood at 71,501.12 TPA as compared to 74,381 TPA in FY 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to maintain the status of a zero-debt company.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors have recommended a Final Dividend of `1/- (100 %) per Equity Share (of face value of `1/- each) for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026 which is subject to approval of the shareholders of the Company in the ensuing 42nd Annual General Meeting.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ABS business in India is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuation risks because key raw materials are import-dependent.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects optimal utilization of its expanded capacity by end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The commissioning of the enhanced capacity up to 1,00,000 TPA is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
